Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code) in this modern, enterprise-grade, cross-platform dotfiles repository (macOS, Linux, WSL); tiered shell, tmux, and Neovim configurations.

Install and CLI commands:
```sh
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup              # Idempotent environment setup
dot check              # Comprehensive health validation
dot update             # Update all components
dot reload             # Reload shell configuration
dot project init       # Create new project
dot ai review          # AI code review
dot security scan      # Security audit
dot metrics dashboard  # View system metrics
dot plugin list        # Manage plugins
dot migrate status     # Check for updates
```

Testing and validation:
```sh
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check                    # Full system health check
dot doctor                   # Diagnose issues
dot test run                 # Run all tests
perf-status                  # Check performance
perf-bench                   # Run benchmarks
perf-quick                   # One-command optimization
```

Structure: `bin/` (DOT CLI/utilities), `config/` (templates/core configs), `lib/` (libraries), `plugins/` (plugins), `scripts/` (installer/utilities), `tests/` (test framework). Main interface: `bin/dot`, orchestrating modular CLI libraries in `lib/cli/`: `core.sh` (setup/check/update), `ai.sh` (AI), `security.sh` (scanning/hardening), `project.sh` (projects), `testing.sh` (tests/reporting).

Tools are declarative in `config/tools.yaml`; profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Automatic OS/distro and package-manager detection; progressive shell, tmux, and Neovim tiers. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`; template: `plugins/local/hello-world/`. Neovim: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`; tiers include 8 essential, 23 enhanced, and 33+ advanced plugins. Tmux: `config/tmux/tmux.conf`, `config/tmux/core.conf`; 10 essential keybindings, Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, | and - splits. Zsh: `config/zsh/`; fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms) modes; resource auto-detection, autosuggestions, history management.

Add tools: edit `config/tools.yaml`, add to essential/development/optional, then run:
